title: With Your Shield, or On It

panels.visual: A Spartan mother handing a round bronze shield with a lambda to her young son, stern pride, a hint of tears
panels.caption: When my son goes to war, I hand him his shield.

speech.speaker: Mother
speech.text: Come back with this, or on it.

panels.visual: A line of soldiers carried home on their shields on a funeral march, a mother at the roadside standing straight
panels.caption: Win, or be carried home dead on it.

panels.visual: A fleeing soldier throwing away his shield in panic, a Spartan woman's disapproving face in an inset
panels.caption: Never throw it away to run.

panels.visual: Spartan girls racing, wrestling and learning to be strong; a woman overseeing an estate with scrolls and farm workers
panels.caption: Spartan girls run races and wrestle. Women can own land and run the estates while the men are at war.
